gold.name: Gold
gold.desc: Money in the bank. Pays for factories, fortresses, recruits and reforms.

goldYear.name: Gold a year
goldYear.desc: Taxes, factory output and sea trade over a year. The great power with the most in {rules.end.season|season} {rules.end.year} meets its ambition.

taxes.name: Taxes
taxes.desc: Gold the people pay. Falls with unrest, occupation and every man in the army.

upkeep.name: Army upkeep
upkeep.desc: Gold the army costs every season.

trade.name: Sea trade
trade.desc: Gold from coastal provinces. Lost while the nation is at war.

save.name: Save gold
save.desc: The ministers keep the gold when nothing else is expected to pay.

province.name: Provinces
province.desc: Land a nation holds. Each one costs a little to run.

capital.name: Capital
capital.desc: Where a nation is ruled from. Its army size shows here in wartime.

pop.name: People
pop.desc: How many live in a province or nation, in millions.

culture.name: Nationality
culture.desc: The people of a province. Under a ruler of another nationality they grow restless.

settle.name: Integrated
settle.desc: How far a conquered province has become part of its new nation. It pays little until fully integrated.

occupied.name: Occupied
occupied.desc: Held by an enemy army. Pays its owner nothing until freed.

sea.name: Sea crossing
sea.desc: Two coastal provinces close enough to invade across the water.

claim.name: Claims
claim.desc: Nations that want a province: its old owner, its own people, or a nation uniting it.

factory.name: Factories
factory.desc: Produce gold every season. Each new one costs more and adds less.

fort.name: Fortress
fort.desc: Stops a share of enemy advances into the province. Razed if the province falls.

buildFactory.name: Factory being built
buildFactory.desc: A factory under construction. Takes {rules.build.factory|word} seasons.

buildFort.name: Fortress being built
buildFort.desc: A fortress under construction. Takes {rules.build.fort|word} seasons.

build.name: Construction
build.desc: Gold spent this season on factories and fortresses.

ruin.name: Ruin
ruin.desc: A factory or fortress destroyed in war.

boom.name: Boom
boom.desc: Coal is found or a railway arrives: the province suddenly pays more.

reform.name: Reforms
reform.desc: Laws that calm unrest for a while. Cost gold.

unrest.name: Unrest
unrest.desc: Anger in a province ruled by another nationality. Cuts taxes; at {rules.unrest.uprising} or more it is close to an uprising.

uprising.name: Uprising
uprising.desc: A province rises against its ruler and may break away or join its own people.

army.name: Army
army.desc: Men under arms, in thousands. Deters attack and wins wars, but every man is a worker lost.

war.name: War
war.desc: Nations fighting over a province. Ends when one side wins or both are exhausted.

battle.name: Battle
battle.desc: Fighting in a province this season.

front.name: Front line
front.desc: Where the two sides of a war hold land face to face.

goal.name: War goal
goal.desc: The province a war is being fought for.

peace.name: Peace
peace.desc: A war ends and land or gold changes hands.

dead.name: Dead
dead.desc: Lives lost in the fighting, in millions.

ally.name: Alliance
ally.desc: Nations that usually join each other's wars, and nearly always each other's defence.

rival.name: Biggest threat
rival.desc: The neighbour a nation fears most. It arms and allies against it.

proclaim.name: Proclamation
proclaim.desc: A divided people united: the nation that holds enough of its lands takes its new name, and the smaller nations of its people join it.

ambition.name: Ambition
ambition.desc: What a nation must achieve by the armistice of {rules.end.season|season} {rules.end.year}: be the richest great power, unite its people, or survive.

leader.name: Leading nation
leader.desc: The nation with the most gold a year right now.

ruler.name: Ruler
ruler.desc: Who decides for the nation, with his own patience, judgment, thrift and trait.

patience.name: Patience
patience.desc: How many years ahead a ruler counts gains and costs.

thrift.name: Thrift
thrift.desc: How dear a ruler holds his gold. A thrifty one hoards it and builds little; a lavish one spends it on factories, recruits and reforms.

judgment.name: Judgment
judgment.desc: Whether a ruler sees his odds in war as better or worse than they are.

forecast.name: Forecasts
forecast.desc: What each option is worth in gold over the ruler's horizon. Positive ones are done, best first.

civilWar.name: Civil war
civilWar.desc: A disputed succession: rival claimants split the army, which fights at {rules.reign.crisisArmy|frac} strength.

coup.name: Coup
coup.desc: The army deposes the ruler of a restless nation.

event.name: Event
event.desc: Famines, epidemics, panics, booms and other turns of fortune.

panel.name: Side panel
panel.desc: Shows or hides the chronicle, rankings and details on the right.

almanac.name: Almanac
almanac.desc: Every ruler, nation, people, ambition, event and rule in the game, read live from the game's own data (key A).

nation.name: Nation
nation.desc: A realm on the map, with its own ruler, gold and army.

reroll.name: Reroll
reroll.desc: Deal {rules.heirs|word} new heirs instead of these (key R). {rules.rerolls|Word} free rerolls a game.

rarity.name: Rarity
rarity.desc: How rare a ruler is, from {rarities.0.name} to {rarities.4.name}. The rarer he is, the more he can change the game.

guarantee.name: Guarantor
guarantee.desc: A great power sworn to defend a nation born in an uprising for {rules.newNation.guarantee|span}: it always joins its wars.

major.name: Great power
major.desc: One of the {rules.majors.count|word} strongest nations, recounted every {rules.majors.every|span}. Great powers step in against a nation that grows too strong, guarantee nations born in uprisings and fight the {events.greatWar.name}. The great powers of {rules.start} race to be the richest.

advance.name: Development
advance.desc: A permanent national advance. Chosen from scheduled offers, it survives changes of ruler.
